metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can give both quick AND long-lasting relief for nerve pain the neck.

These exercises are especially good for helping with sharp, shooting pains caused from a bulging or herniated disc (the main cause of a pinched nerve).   

Let us know how they work for you!

0:00 Intro
0:33 Tension Release
3:42 Traction Exercise
